{{Quote|They've arrived!|This guard talking to a fellow one|<ref name="Bounty" />}}
A [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]] '''guard''' lived on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quarzite/Legends|Quarzite]] and worked for [[Major/Legends|Major]] [[Rigosso/Legends|Rigosso]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], this [[Belugan/Legends|Belugan]], along with a [[Unidentified Belugan guard 2|fellow guard]] served under Major Rigosso and joined a group made up of six [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]], [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]], [[Bossk/Legends|Bossk]], [[Dengar/Legends|Dengar]], [[Latts Razzi/Legends|Latts Razzi]], [[C-21 Highsinger/Legends|C-21 Highsinger]], and [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]]. This force was created to [[Safe cargo objective/Legends|protect]] a very important [[Pluma Sodi/Legends|cargo]] shipment that was to be delivered to Belugan leader [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Otua Blank/Legends|Otua Blank]].
While en route to to Blank, [[Kage Warriors/Legends|Kage Warriors]] attacked the [[Subtram/Legends|subtram]] the Belugans were traveling on, and were able to throw both guards over the rails, though they likely survived their falls.<ref name="Bounty" />
